_comment: Single source for the Playwright specs that need a live fixture backend. Read by scripts/gate/release_gate.py (only specs with gate=true: FIXTURE_SPECS) and by scripts/fixture_job.py (the `fixture` job of private/runner/run_smart.py). Do not change a gate flag without noting it in docs/operations/RUNNER_FIXTURE_JOB.md.
_schema: GATE-FIXTURE-LANE-2530. A group = one throwaway backend (or none) + one vite preview of frontend/dist. script: the fixture backend (null = no backend: mocked specs that only need their env; the preview proxies to a dead port). seed: run after the backend is up. backend_env: extra env of the backend. pw_env: env of Playwright. extra_ports: free ports right above the API port (default 1). then: follow-up stages on the SAME data dir - the backend restarts on the same port with the stage's backend_env and the group's specs run again with the stage's pw_env merged in. specs: {name: {gate, projects}}; a spec may sit in more than one group (other env). Placeholders in backend_env / pw_env values: {port} (the API port), {port+N}, {out} (a fresh output folder of the group under the run's logs). A spec with gate=true runs in every tier-L release gate (the fixture lane, docs/testing/GATE_LANES.md section 5) and in a GATE_LANE=fixture run (scripts/gate/fixture_lane.sh).
_hud_layout: the layout guard of the HUD over the floor map reads every skin at 390 / 768 / 1440 px (~18 min on the runner): two specs / groups (evidence-hud-layout-live.spec.ts: classic, domus, tesla; -b: bubble, crystal) keep each under the fixture job's 20-minute group limit; SW_HUD_SHOTS=1 also writes the pictures into docs/design/evidence/hud-layout/ (untracked on the runner; copy them back, look at them, commit the ones that are evidence)

media_ma._why_not_gate: GATE-FIXTURE-LANE-2530 runner run (2026-11-25): ma 43 pass / 6 fail, sonos 40 pass / 4 fail, all failing again alone. The spec was written against the CR-016 contract before S1-S3 merged (its header: UNVERIFIED until they meet a real server); the failures are such guesses - 'unplaced devices are listed last', the favourites tab text, the group-leave outcome ('left' expected, 'unknown' answered), a cross-brand group's room name. A spec (or product) follow-up first, then gate: true.

wiskey._why_not_gate: GATE-FIXTURE-LANE-2530 runner run (2026-11-25): the three specs still drive the pre-CR-036 people screen (sw-table[data-wiskey-people-table] rows from /intercom/people); the native people screen (CR-036 S7) reads /api/v1/access-control/people and draws div.tablewrap[data-wiskey-people-table], so every first test of the three serial groups fails (no row in 30 s) and the rest do not run. A stale-spec fix (and the fixture's access-control answers) is a follow-up row; flip gate to true when they pass with `fixture_job.py evidence-wiskey-people evidence-wiskey-editor evidence-wiskey-capture`.
